title: vouacapoua retusa
intro: Vouacapoua retusa, commonly known as the "African walnut," is a plant species native to West Africa, characterized by its distinctive walnut-like fruit. The health benefits of Vouacapoua retusa include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Vouacapoua retusa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
